newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly lower.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were seen opening slightly lower Wednesday, in line with LME copper, after a further rise in LME warehouse copper stocks Tuesday.
COMEX September copper was seen opening unchanged to down 0.30 cent a pound from Tuesday's close at 110.75 cents, after trading a 110.50-110.25 cent range in overnight ACCESS trade.
LME copper stocks rose a further 6,350 tonnes Wednesday to 226,950 tonnes, and have now doubled in about a month, as the seasonally slow summer period continues to see demand ease.
COMEX copper stocks rose 1,285 short tons Tuesday to 29,790 short tons.
Copper prices have been recovering in the past week, from three month lows seen in early July, following a rally to 12 month highs.
